explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` to parse the HTML fragment in body context, then walked tokens with `next_token()`, concatenating only `#text` tokens plus opener text from `TITLE` and `TEXTAREA` via `get_modifiable_text()`. The result is truncated by Unicode code points with `mb_strlen()` and `mb_substr()` when available, preserving whitespace and decoded character references.
